name: A Clown's Appearance
source:
An immortal Jester has randomly spawned in your house! They're sporadic, silly, and weirdly friendly.

It's up to you to help him back onto his feet in a city he's unfamiliar with! Will you two live amicably until he can move out, or bump heads? 

[From [url=https://purrpup.itch.io/aclownsappearance]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个不朽的小丑随机出现在你的房子里！他们是零星的、愚蠢的、而且奇怪地友好。

你需要帮助他在陌生的城市重新站起来！你们两个会和睦相处直到他搬出去，或者发生冲突吗？

[来自[url=https://purrpup.itch.io/aclownsappearance]itch.io[/url]]
